title: Check if an array represents a min-heap or not
intro: Heaps give O(log n) push/pop of extremes. Reach for them for “top-k” and running medians.
intuition: Parent is always extreme of its subtree — extract-min/max in log time.
approach: Keep heap size within k if top-k.

complexity.time: O(n log n) or O(n log k)
